am-opus-r1/test-01.interpretation: The pooled protein-cluster interval supports a positive axis association within this panel. Nominal within-panel estimates using the corrected official-score join; reconstructed splits do not establish independence of original axis selection.
am-opus-r1/test-01.aggregation_and_uncertainty: Arithmetic means of eligible assay-level absolute Spearman correlations and matched assay-level endpoint contrasts, preserving assay weighting. Percentile 95% intervals use 10,000 whole-protein bootstrap draws. Two-sided protein-block sign-flip tests use exact enumeration for at most 16 proteins or 50,000 Monte Carlo draws otherwise and assume joint sign symmetry within each protein. All assays of one protein move together; assay/protein counts and limited-cluster flags are reported. Intervals/tests are nominal and are not multiplicity-adjusted.
